nodes.label: Backpressure (queue.max_pending)
nodes.rationale: Bounded backlog: reject with busy_message instead of queueing without limit.

nodes.label: Graceful drain on SIGTERM
nodes.rationale: Stop intake and finish backlog within drain_timeout_seconds.

nodes.label: Horizontal scaling with Redis
nodes.rationale: Shared queue/state lets N chatbot replicas consume the same backlog.

nodes.label: Host-only ports / minimal public surface
nodes.rationale: Only /webhook and /health public via Caddy; everything else 127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: Idempotency by msg_id
nodes.rationale: Meta redelivers webhooks for ~24h; dedup at ingest.

nodes.label: Leaked Ollama key remediation
nodes.rationale: Rotate key, purge history with git filter-repo, keep repo private.

nodes.label: One deployment per bot/process
nodes.rationale: Own .env, config profile, tree.md, knowledge_base and REDIS_PREFIX.

nodes.label: Non-root container + pinned images
nodes.rationale: UID 10001; deliberate image upgrades.

nodes.label: Sizing rule workers x replicas <= OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
nodes.norm_label: sizing rule workers x replicas <= ollama_num_parallel
nodes.rationale: More workers than LLM capacity only produces timeouts.

nodes.label: At-least-once delivery (Redis)
nodes.rationale: Message leaves its mailbox only after the handler returns; done:<msg_id> marker skips replays.

nodes.label: LLM circuit breaker
nodes.rationale: Fail fast with fallback when the LLM is down instead of waiting for every timeout.

nodes.label: Config profiles config.<APP_ENV>.yaml
nodes.rationale: Per-environment/tenant overlay deep-merged over config.yaml.

nodes.label: Conversation state with TTL
nodes.rationale: History + tree session live in a state store and expire after inactivity.
